## Docs

Every page below is available as raw markdown.

- [Contributing](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/community/contributing.md): How to contribute to Flowforge
- [License](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/community/license.md): MIT License terms and what it means for you
- [API Reference](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/essentials/api-reference.md): Complete reference for Flowforge configuration methods.
- [Customization](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/essentials/customization.md): Customize your Kanban boards with rich content, actions, and filtering.
- [Database Schema](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/essentials/database-schema.md): Set up your database for drag-and-drop Kanban functionality.
- [Integration Patterns](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/essentials/integration-patterns.md): Three ways to integrate Flowforge into your application.
- [Swimlanes](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/essentials/swimlanes.md): Group a board into lanes by assignee, priority or any other field.
- [Troubleshooting](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/essentials/troubleshooting.md): Common issues and solutions for Flowforge implementation.
- [Installation](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/getting-started/installation.md): Get started with Flowforge in 90 seconds.
- [Upgrading](https://relaticle.github.io/flowforge/v5/raw/flowforge/v5/getting-started/upgrading.md): Upgrade guide for Flowforge
